author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Astra successfully build a 74181, one shot, zero human knowledge, only the spec, tools doc. LEC equivalent to the one build by Opus and Sol

It is cheaper than Opus and Sol.

Gemini-3.8 failed the test, it got the polarity of a pin wrong.

author.name: Thejas Koneripalli Govindarajulu
author.headline: Senior DV Engineer | SystemVerilog/UVM | Formal Verification | AXI/PCIe | AI‑Driven DV | Machine Learning”

comments.text: Human evaluation is still required. LEC proves equivalence to the chosen reference under the verification assumptions. Two implementations can pass equivalence while sharing the same specification error. Engineers still need to review pin polarity, specification interpretation, and the LEC setup. One-shot success and lower cost are valuable, but they don’t replace independent validation and human accountability.
